SKILLS SUMMARY
Organization: EPAM (Client: Atlassian) — RemoteEnvironment: LlamaIndex, Anthropic Claude API, Node.js, Redis, WebSockets, Google CalendarAPI, Microsoft Outlook Calendar APIDescription: Developed a real-time scheduling agent integrating LlamaIndex with Google andOutlook calendar APIs. Integrated an intelligent conversational agent that automatically resolvestime-zone conflicts, reschedules dropouts, and delivers automated pre-interview reminders.Roles & Responsibilities:• Built real-time multi-calendar scheduling workflows with automated conflict resolution andrescheduling.• Automated 90% of manual recruiter coordination tasks, reducing interviewdropouts/no-shows by 30%.• Implemented conversational scheduling using LlamaIndex and Anthropic Claude API, withRedis and WebSockets for low-latency state and real-time updates.Organization: Emirates National Bank Dubai (D4Insight) — Remote | Mar 2025 – PresentEnvironment: Node.js (TypeScript, Nest/Express), Microservices, AWS, PostgreSQL/DynamoDB,Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, DatadogDescription: Built a fault-tolerant decisioning platform orchestrating multiple AI/ML models forcredit-risk based on repayment patterns and behavioral data; enabled real-time approvals withexplainability and continuous-feedback loops.Roles & Responsibilities:• Designed microservices with saga/outbox patterns for reliable workflows.• Implemented model orchestration (inference routing, retraining hooks, feedback capture).• Automated compliance checks with LLM-driven document parsing.• Established observability (tracing, logs, metrics) and CI/CD for safe rollouts.Loan Decision Management System (Personal & Corporate Lending) — SeniorSoftware Developer
Paytm Travel – Booking & Automation — Software DeveloperOrganization: Paytm — Bengaluru | Dec 2021 – Aug 2023Environment: Node.js, TypeScript, Micro-apps, RabbitMQ/Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker,CI/CDDescription: Built OTP Booking and Cancellation Protect modules; automated 75% of manualworkflows; migrated a monolith to modular micro-apps, improving deployment velocity; launchedResume Booking to rehydrate abandoned flows (+10% retention).Roles & Responsibilities:Sendhelper App Revamp (Consumer Services Platform) — Senior SoftwareDeveloperOrganization: PropertyGuru (Sendhelper) — Bengaluru | Aug 2023 – Mar 2025Environment: Node.js, TypeScript, Express/NestJS, AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB,CloudWatch), Redis, PostgreSQL, Braze, Datadog, GitHub ActionsDescription: Led backend revamp delivering +35% sign-ups and +19% conversion; builtAI-driven dynamic pricing & demand forecasting resulting in +34% off-peak revenue, plusrecommendation modules from behavior data.Roles & Responsibilities:• Re-architected critical services for scalability & reliability; added 2FA & lockout.• Integrated Braze for lifecycle automation & analytics.• Used Cursor/Copilot to uplift code quality and delivery speed.• Event-driven integrations and resilient workflows with retries & DLQs.• API hardening, caching, and performance tuning under peak loads.
Enterprise Platforms (Survey Cert & Loan Processing) — Senior SoftwareEngineerOrganization: Infosys — Bengaluru | Aug 2018 – Jun 2021Environment: Node.js/Express, Redis, SQL, React (frontends), CI/CDDescription: Rebuilt Caterpillar Survey Certification backend for reliability/perf; developed loanprocessing platform improving TAT and throughput; enhanced CI/CD for React & Node fordeployment stability and QA.Roles & Responsibilities:English (Fluent), Hindi (Native)B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering — JSS Academy of Technical Education, India(2014–2018)• Designed APIs, caching layers, and DB optimizations.• Strengthened CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.• Business Impact: +35% user acquisition, +19% conversions, +34% revenue uplift via dynamicpricing.• Architecture Modernization: Legacy → microservices/serverless, 99.9% uptime maintained.• AI in Production: Credit-risk scoring, dynamic pricing, recommendations; AI-assisted codingadoption.EDUCATIONLANGUAGESKEY
